title: North Korea fires several missiles into Sea of Japan
paragraphs: North Korea fires several missiles into Sea of Japan
South Korea's Joint Chiefs of Staff said its military "detected several missiles launched from the Sondok area of North Korea towards the East Sea on the morning of Nov 4".

SEOUL: North Korea fired several missiles off its east coast on Wednesday (Nov 4), Seoul's military said, extending a burst of weapons testing as Pyongyang hardens its stance toward South Korea and the United States.
